Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 67: February 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #67 was shipped to subscribers in January 2007 (bearing the cover date of February 2007 for Issue 67). Built as a native Xbox 360-exclusive disc, it featured playable 360 game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trial games, and downloadable content (DLC):

The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion (playable content / DLC features)
Call of Duty 3 (tactical WWII first-person shooter)
Superman Returns (open-world superhero action)
Cars (arcade racing tie-in)
Eragon (fantasy action-adventure)
Small Arms (Xbox Live Arcade multiplayer platform brawler)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc featured downloadable dashboard media (gamerpics and custom themes), offline backward-compatibility updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews and galleries—including early features for Mass Effect, Dark Sector, and NBA Street Homecourt, alongside OXM's monthly poll, quiz, and Top Plays segment.
